text:
Hello lounge team,
The arrivals lead sent an update on welfare walks

Please keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk notes tight and current today. We have a few routine handoffs moving through the lounge, and I need everyone checking carrier labels, water bowls, and comfort notes before any pet is moved on. If a traveler seems unsure, slow the process down and give the same clear guidance every time. Safety stays ahead of speed on every journey, and that has to show in the way we speak and work.

If you see any gap in the paperwork or a mismatch in the animal care instructions, flag it right away and do not assume someone else has it covered. The desk should stay calm, steady, and friendly, even when the flow picks up. Aurelia Skyways relies on us to keep the companion animal handoff clean and reassuring, so let us be sharp with details and generous with support.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
